verses.text: "Son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say, 'Mountains of Israel, listen to the LORD's message.
This is what the Lord GOD says: The enemy said about you, "Aha! The ancient heights are now ours."

So prophesy and say, This is what the Lord GOD says: Enemies ruined you and attacked you from every side, so that you became the property of the rest of the nations. People talked about you and spread slander.

So, mountains of Israel, listen to the message of the Lord GOD. This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys, to the desolate ruins and the deserted towns that have been robbed and mocked by the rest of the nations around you.

This is what the Lord GOD says: In my burning jealousy I have spoken against the rest of the nations and against all of Edom. With glee and with scorn in their hearts, they took over my land for themselves so that they could loot its pastures.'

So prophesy about the land of Israel. Say to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: I speak in my jealous fury, because you have suffered the insults of the nations.
So this is what the Lord GOD says: I raise my hand and swear that the nations around you will also suffer insults.
But you, mountains of Israel, will grow branches and produce fruit for my people Israel, because they will soon come home.
Look, I am on your side. I will turn to you, and you will be plowed and planted.
I will make the population grow throughout the whole land of Israel. The towns will be lived in again, and the ruins will be rebuilt.

I will make people and animals increase on you. They will grow in number and have many children. I will settle people on you as in the past and make you more prosperous than before. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
I will make people, my people Israel, walk on you again. They will own you, and you will be their inheritance. You will never again take their children from them.
This is what the Lord GOD says: People say to you, "You devour people and take away the children of your nation."
But you will no longer devour people or take away the children of your nation, says the Lord GOD.
I will no longer let you hear the insults of the nations. You will no longer suffer the scorn of the peoples or make your nation fall, says the Lord GOD.'"
The LORD's message came to me:

"Son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own land, they made it unclean by the way they lived and what they did. To me their conduct was like a woman's uncleanness during her period.
So I poured out my fury on them because they had spilled blood in the land and made it unclean with their idols.
I scattered them among the nations and spread them throughout the countries. I judged them by the way they lived and what they did.
But wherever they went among the nations, they dishonored my holy name. People said about them, 'These are the LORD's people, and yet they had to leave his land.'
I was concerned for my holy name, which the people of Israel dishonored among the nations where they went.

So say to the people of Israel, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: I am not doing this for your sake, people of Israel, but for the sake of my holy name, which you have dishonored among the nations where you went.

I will show the holiness of my great name, which has been dishonored among the nations, the name you have dishonored among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, says the Lord GOD, when I show my holiness through you before their eyes.
For I will take you out of the nations and gather you from all the countries, and I will bring you back into your own land.
I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will make you clean from all your uncleanness and from all your idols.
I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you. I will take away your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
I will put my Spirit in you and move you to follow my rules and be careful to keep my laws.
You will live in the land I gave your ancestors. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and make it plentiful, and I will not bring famine on you.
I will make the fruit trees and the crops of the field produce more, so that you will never again be disgraced among the nations because of famine.
Then you will remember your evil ways and the wrong things you did, and you will hate yourselves for your sins and disgusting practices.
I want you to know that I am not doing this for your sake, says the Lord GOD. Be ashamed and embarrassed by the way you have lived, people of Israel!
This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I make you clean from all your sins, I will settle people in your towns again, and the ruins will be rebuilt.
The desolate land will be farmed again, instead of lying in ruins for everyone who passes by to see.
They will say, "This land that was ruined has become like the garden of Eden. The towns that were destroyed, ruined, and torn down are now strong and full of people."
Then the nations around you that are left will know that I, the LORD, have rebuilt what was destroyed and replanted what was desolate. I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it.
This is what the Lord GOD says: Once again I will let the people of Israel ask me to do this for them: I will make their people as many as a flock of sheep.
They will be as many as the sheep brought for sacrifice in Jerusalem during her festivals. That is how the ruined towns will be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"
